response.rationale: C1 is the most complete candidate because the same CDSN biallelic-mutation span supports both the specific genetic etiology and the autosomal-recessive inference, while the supragranular split supports the peeling phenotype. R4 shares the CDSN etiology but omits inheritance; R3 shares the CDSN mutation but omits the gene and inheritance in its label; R2 is generic; R5 is contradicted by truncal distribution and lacks CDSN support.
